meta.title: Mountain overlook
meta.place: Alpine hiking overlook at sunrise: cantilevered timber deck, stone switchback, rock outcrop, gapahuk shelter
notes: View and layered peaks are -Z. Sunrise key light comes from +X.
Walking surface is the stone switchback, the shelter spur, and the timber deck.
The view bench is the reused museum bench, oriented so its depth axis faces the peaks.

must_read: A stone switchback climbs a sculpted shoulder to a cantilevered timber deck.
The deck projects over a drop toward layered peaks, with a bench facing that view.
A modest three-walled shelter sits off the trail as the secondary place to sit.
Pines are irregular and grasses are clumped. The ground is not a flat platform.
